purpose: Bind the jointly accepted Phase 2 closure to the current deterministic concurrency harness without weakening or replacing any retained Phase 2 obligation.

trigger.observed_failure: the retained Phase 2 rerun passed but its canonical report identity changed according to which different-idempotency-key contender won the admission race
trigger.root_cause: schedule.same-snapshot-different-key.admission used a two-party admission barrier but left post-barrier lock acquisition to operating-system scheduling; the report serialized contender order and the winning rebuild receipt hash

deterministic_schedule_contract.precondition: both contenders activate and complete the same admission snapshot before either proceeds past the controlled yield
deterministic_schedule_contract.selected_interleaving: the left contender proceeds first; the right contender resumes only after the left contender reaches a terminal
deterministic_schedule_contract.required_observation: left passes with a rebuild receipt and right is rejected with projection_rebuild_snapshot_conflict
deterministic_schedule_contract.why_semantics_are_preserved: the schedule still proves that two independently admitted different-key commands cannot both commit the same snapshot; only the scheduler choice is made reproducible

semantic_normalization.algorithm: remove artifact content_sha256, replace report.run_manifest_sha256 with <source-bound>, and replace only the adapter digest in report.run_manifest_component_sha256 with <adapter-source-bound>, then hash canonical JSON

focused_regression.red_evidence: the uncorrected harness produced opposite winners and unequal detail payloads across two fresh runs
focused_regression.green_evidence: the corrected harness produced the same ordered terminal evidence across two fresh runs

non_claims: This addendum does not reopen or rewrite the jointly accepted Phase 2 closure packet.
This addendum does not waive an obligation, mutant, fault cell, concurrency schedule, invariant, or effect boundary.
This addendum does not authorize runtime Diagnostic UI, production release, real-workspace mutation, runtime safety authority, outbound effects, or hardware control.
